result:
I’d make other people’s suffering impossible to ignore when your choices contribute to it.

Not in a punishing way—just total clarity: if your comfort, ambition, or indifference harms someone far away or easily overlooked, you’d feel a genuine fraction of its weight. I think most cruelty survives because distance and abstraction make strangers feel less real.
